honesty.no_merge_has_been_performed: Every entry below is a PROPOSED merge or composition derived from a field the blueprint author wrote during discovery. No two workflows have been merged, run, or compared head-to-head. Zero of these maps is executable capability.
honesty.composition_graph_is_not_a_clustering: The compat graph is a SINGLE connected component spanning all 108 blueprints, so it cannot partition the library. Use family_composition_matrix (cross-family edge counts) for structure; do not read 'connected' as 'related'.
honesty.UNVERIFIED: No composition pair has been executed together. Settling probe: pick the highest-degree cross-family pair and run both blueprints on one task, then run each alone, and compare on the gates each declares.

FINDING_asymmetric_compat.statement: 140 of 390 compat references are declared in one direction only. 'Composes with' is a symmetric relation, so a one-sided declaration is a data defect, not a directional edge.
FINDING_asymmetric_compat.consequence: Any consumer that reads compat as directed will under-count composition partners by up to 140 edges.
FINDING_asymmetric_compat.settling_probe: Symmetrise compat in the source data (_bp_data_*.py) and re-emit the library; the undirected edge count must stay 265 while the declared-ref count rises to 530.
